reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Natural person licensed professional incorporators
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: one or more licensed natural persons may incorporate a professional corporation for the same or multiple permitted professional services under §§ 356.011–356.261.

headings.title: Articles of incorporation contents and licensing authority certificates
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: articles state professional purpose, initial street address, and chapter 351 requirements; licensing authority certificate(s) verifying licensure, joint-practice permission, and name approval filed with secretary of state.

headings.title: Articles amendment changing corporate name and regulatory approval certificate
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: name-change amendments must attach and reference licensing authority approval certificate(s) in addition to chapter 351 requirements.

headings.title: Licensing authority rulemaking for certificate issuance fees
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: authorizes each licensing authority to promulgate rules setting reasonable fees for § 356.041 certificates.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 356.041 (bid 19320), all four subsections, and source note (L. 1986 H.B. 1230). Retained all four titles.

headings.title: General corporate powers, permitted investments, and business entity partnerships
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1(1)-(2): grants chapter 351 powers; allows investments consistent with sub 2 and participation only in enterprises rendering authorized professional services or permitted/ancillary business.

headings.title: Limitation strictly to permitted professions and businesses
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: professional corporation may not engage in any profession or business other than those permitted by its articles.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 356.061 (bid 19322), both subsections with subdivisions, and source note (L. 1986 H.B. 1230). Retained both titles.

headings.title: Eligible share purchasers, revocable trusts, partnerships, and LLCs
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1(1)-(4): restricts issuance of shares/options/securities to licensed natural persons, qualifying revocable trusts, licensed general partnerships, authorized professional corporations, and licensed LLCs.

headings.title: Licensing authority share restrictions and voiding of unlawful shares
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: licensing authority may further restrict share issuance by rule to prevent ethics violations (without disqualifying existing shareholders); shares issued in violation are void.

headings.title: Permitted share transfer classes and voiding of unlawful transfers
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: limits share transfers/pledges to qualified natural persons, general partnerships, qualifying revocable trusts, and professional corporations (LLCs omitted from sub 3 list); unlawful transfers are void except by operation of law or court decree.

headings.title: Mandatory transfer restriction notice conspicuously stated on share certificates
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: share certificates must conspicuously state on their face that shares are subject to §§ 356.011–356.261 and licensing-authority transfer restrictions.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 356.111 (bid 19327), all four subsections with subdivisions (1)-(4), and history/effective-date notes (L. 1986, A.L. 1991, A.L. 1993, effective 12-01-93). Noted sub 3 transfer list omits LLCs despite sub 1(4) issuance eligibility; retained all four titles.

headings.title: Mandatory transfer, redemption, or purchase upon shareholder death or disqualification
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: upon death, disqualification, or operation-of-law/court-decree transfer to a disqualified person, shares may be transferred to a qualified person or must be purchased/redeemed to the extent legally available funds allow.

headings.title: Share price determination by governing documents or agreement
headings.reviewNote: Refined title (removed unstated appraisal). Verified sub 2: price/terms set by articles, bylaws, private written agreement, or post-event agreement, payable within 30 days (or agreed period) upon certificate surrender.

headings.title: Mandatory financial statements delivery to estate or disqualified shareholder
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: absent governing-document or private price terms, corporation must deliver balance sheet (<=12 months old) and 12-month P&L statement within 30 days.

headings.title: Court petition for fair value determination and quasi in rem jurisdiction
headings.reviewNote: Corrected note (petition arises if no agreement within 90 days). Verified sub 4: plenary quasi in rem proceeding in registered-office county, installment payment option, appraiser appointment, and equitable interest.

headings.title: Court assessment of proceedings costs, expenses, and attorney fees
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 5: costs/appraiser expenses assessed against corporation (apportionable for arbitrary/vexatious/bad-faith refusal); discretionary counsel/expert fee award if fair value materially exceeds offer or no offer made.

headings.title: Automatic share cancellation upon expiration of statutory deadlines
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 6: shares automatically cancelled on corporate books if uncompleted within 12 months after death or 6 months after disqualification/transfer, leaving only payment/valuation rights.

headings.title: Treasury share status for shares acquired by corporation
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 7: acquired shares may be held and disposed of as treasury shares.

headings.title: Temporary disqualification exception for periods under six months
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 8: mandatory purchase does not apply where disqualification period is less than 6 months.

headings.title: Preemption and specific enforceability of contractual share purchase terms
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 9 (source omits 'of' in 'preempt the right such estate'): articles/bylaws/private purchase provisions are specifically enforceable and preempt statutory valuation suits.

headings.title: Preservation of pension benefits and deferred compensation payments
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 10: does not prevent or relieve paying pension benefits or other deferred compensation as otherwise permitted by law.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 356.141 (bid 19330), all ten subsections, and source note (L. 1986 H.B. 1230). Revised sub 2 title (no appraisal in sub 2) and corrected sub 4 reviewNote (court petition filed if no price agreement within 90 days, not 'within 90 days').

headings.title: Individual liability for personal negligence and supervisory acts
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: employee liable for personal negligent/wrongful acts or omissions and negligent appointment/supervision/participation, but not for other employees' conduct without personal participation.

headings.title: Corporate vicarious liability for employee acts within scope of employment
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: domestic and foreign professional corporations are liable to the same extent as employees acting within scope of employment or apparent authority.

headings.title: Shareholder personal liability parity with general business corporations
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: except as otherwise provided by law, shareholder personal liability is no greater than that of a chapter 351 shareholder.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 356.171 (bid 19333), all three subsections, and source note (L. 1986 H.B. 1230). Retained all three titles.

headings.title: Election to convert to general business corporation under chapter 351
headings.reviewNote: Corrected footnote description (*'of this act' in original rolls). Verified sub 1: majority voting-security election to amend articles to chapter 351, drop 'Professional Corporation'/'P.C.', and file copy with licensing authorities.

headings.title: Dissenting shareholder appraisal rights upon conversion
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: dissenting shareholders have the same chapter 351 rights as shareholders dissenting to a sale/exchange of all or substantially all assets.

headings.title: Mandatory conversion upon cessation of professional services
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: professional corporation ceasing to render professional services must amend articles under sub 1 and conform to chapter 351.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 356.201 (bid 19336), all three subsections, and original-rolls footnote (*Words 'of this act' appear in original rolls). Corrected sub 1 reviewNote (removed erroneous claim of repealed sections); retained all three titles.

headings.title: Corporate registration report filing requirement and list of officers and shareholders
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: domestic and foreign professional corporations file § 351.120/§ 351.122 corporate registration reports listing names and residence/business addresses of all officers, directors, and shareholders.

headings.title: Secretary of state prescribed report form and execution
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: report made on secretary of state form and executed by an officer or authorized person.

headings.title: Filing fees, late penalties, and filing schedule
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: § 351.122/§ 351.125 filing fee, possible late penalty fees by secretary of state, and § 351.120/§ 351.122 deadlines.

headings.title: Statutory penalties under chapter 351 for failure to file
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: failure to file a qualifying report when due subjects the corporation to chapter 351 failure-to-file provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 356.211 (bid 19337), all four subsections, and history notes (L. 1986 through A.L. 2009 H.B. 481). Retained all four titles.

headings.title: Merger or consolidation conditioned on shareholder qualification
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: professional corporation may merge or consolidate with a domestic or foreign corporation only if every shareholder of each corporation qualifies as a shareholder of the surviving/new corporation.

headings.title: Compliance requirements for surviving corporations rendering Missouri services
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: surviving/new corporation rendering professional services in Missouri must immediately comply with §§ 356.011–356.261; otherwise it is not subject to them and may not provide Missouri professional services.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 356.221 (bid 19338), both subsections, and source note (L. 1986 H.B. 1230). Retained both titles.

headings.title: Certificate of authority required for foreign professional corporations and excluded activities
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1(1)-(6): foreign professional corporations need a secretary of state certificate of authority to provide professional services, excluding litigation, internal meetings, bank accounts, borrowing/security, debt collection, and isolated transactions.

headings.title: Prerequisites for procuring foreign certificate of authority
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2(1)-(3): requires compliant corporate name, permitted §§ 356.011–356.261 purposes, and qualified shareholders, majority of directors, and all officers except secretary and treasurer.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 356.231 (bid 19340), both subsections with subdivisions, and source note (L. 1986 H.B. 1230). Retained both titles.
